overview: A Guitar Hero-style rhythm game with 5-lane scrolling notes, neon glows, particle explosions, stage lighting, and full scoring with combos and a health bar.
features: 5-lane scrolling note highway with neon glow (green/red/yellow/blue/orange)
Keyboard (A S D F Space) and on-screen touch controls
Easy/Medium/Hard difficulty with different note density and timing windows
Health bar that drains on misses — game over when empty
Particle explosions and flame/spark effects on note hits
Crowd energy meter reacting to performance
Game over screen with score, accuracy, and restart button
